historical_events.description: Jamaica discovered by Columbus on his third voyage, called it St. Jago
Jamaica capitulated to British force under Admirals Penn and Venables after 161 years of Spanish possession
Slavery abolished in Jamaica, £1,161,927 granted as compensation to slaveowners
Hong Kong, then a desolate island sparsely inhabited by fishermen, first ceded to Great Britain
Charter for Hong Kong government issued
Kow-loon peninsula (28 square miles) ceded to Great Britain by Treaty entered into by Lord Elgin
Sovereignty of Fiji ceded to Her Majesty by Thakombau, Maafu, and other principal chiefs in deed of cession
Epidemic of measles greatly reduced native population
Gibraltar captured by British forces under Sir George Rooke
Gibraltar ceded to Great Britain by Treaty of Utrecht
Gibraltar successfully defended by Gen. Eliot (afterwards Lord Heathfield) during great siege
Falkland Islands discovered by Davis, visited by Hawkins in 1594
Falkland Islands taken possession of by British Government for protection of Whale Fishery
